note: Committed expectation data: the resource-level isModifier elements of the eight types below, projected from the R4 4.0.1 StructureDefinitions named under provenance. Do not hand-edit: re-derive it by the rule.
rule: For each StructureDefinition, every snapshot.element whose path is exactly one segment below the root (<Type>.<name>) and whose isModifier is true. path and isModifierReason are copied verbatim; an absent isModifierReason is null. Types in the order listed under provenance, elements in snapshot order within a type. Each input is checked against the sha256 recorded beside its URL before it is read.
